Captains submit vessel details and declare they have no ties to the U.S., UK, Israel or Saudi Arabia. 
The Houthis typically respond within 24 hours, issuing seven-day transit approvals and navigation instructions.
Source: WSJ

Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas factory by mid-2027 after years of weak sales, shifting capacity to its new Cybercab robotaxi. 
U.S. Cybertruck sales fell 48% to 20,237 in 2025, far below Elon Musk’s original target of 250,000 annually. 
The vehicle faced repeated recalls, quality issues and regulatory barriers in Europe. 
Musk called the move the “end of an era,” as Tesla increasingly focuses on autonomous vehicles and robotics.
Source: Reuters
